```{r}

#########################################################
# Judith Feldhaus dataset
# clean the autoid columns
# Simplify columns 

names(jf)

jf1 <- jf |> dplyr::select(c(IN.FILE, DATE, TIME, HOUR, DATE.12, TIME.12, HOUR.12, AUTO.ID, MATCH.RATIO, SITE, manual.id, AUTO.ID.))
dim(jf1)
# 468400     12

jf2 <- jf1 |> dplyr::mutate(autoid = 
                              factor(dplyr::case_when(
                                is.na(AUTO.ID) ~ AUTO.ID., 
                                TRUE ~ AUTO.ID))) |> 
  dplyr::select(-c(AUTO.ID, AUTO.ID.))

# Now there is one "clean auto id column with no NAs 
# Need to make a new autoid column that is easy to compare with the manual ids 
levels(jf2$autoid)
 # [1] "BARBAR" "EPTNIL" "MYOBRA" "MYODAU" "MYOMYS" "MYONAT" "NoID"   "Noise" 
 # [9] "NYCNOC" "PIPNAT" "PIPPYG" "PLEAUR" "VESMUR"

jf3 <- jf2 |> dplyr::mutate(newauto = 
                              factor(dplyr::case_when(
                                autoid == "BARBAR" ~ "BBAR",
                                autoid == "EPTNIL" ~ "CNIL",
                                autoid %in% c("MYOBRA", "MYODAU", 
                                              "MYOMYS", "MYONAT") ~ "MYSP", 
                                
                                autoid  ==  "NoID" ~ "NoID",
                                autoid  ==  "Noise" ~ "Noise",
                                autoid  ==  "NYCNOC" ~ "NNOC",
                                autoid  ==  "PIPNAT" ~ "PNAT",
                                autoid  ==  "PIPPYG" ~ "PPYG",
                                autoid  ==  "PLEAUR" ~ "PAUR",
                                autoid  ==  "VESMUR" ~ "NYCT")))

names(jf3)

## Rename and check the structure of the columns so they will combine well with the others


jf4 <- jf3 |> 
  dplyr::rename(site = SITE, 
                manualid = manual.id,
                filename = IN.FILE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(site = factor(site), 
                manualid =factor(manualid),
                analyst = factor("Judith Feldhaus")) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(TIME = as.character(TIME), 
                TIME.12 = as.character(TIME.12)) |> 
  dplyr::filter(manualid != "NA") 

summary(jf4)  
dim(jf4)
# 50545    13
# Now only the manually verified files 

names(jf4)
#  [1] "filename"    "DATE"        "TIME"        "HOUR"        "DATE.12"    
#  [6] "TIME.12"     "HOUR.12"     "MATCH.RATIO" "site"        "manualid"   
# [11] "autoid"      "newauto"     "analyst"    

## Clean the manualid column 

levels(jf4$manualid)
summary(jf4$manualid)

whatthis <- jf4 |> dplyr::filter(manualid %in% c("?", "VMUR"))
## I checked the VMUR file - it does look an awful lot like a VMUR social calls but not textbook song, could possibly be NNOC. WIll play it safe and call it NYCT. Not clear to me what "?" obs are, and there are not many, but their autoids tend to be those that are most likely to include bats - so I am assuming NoID

jf5 <- jf4 |> 
  dplyr::mutate(manualid = factor(
    dplyr::case_when(
    manualid == "?" ~ "NoID", 
    manualid == "ENIL" ~ "CNIL",
    manualid == "VMUR" ~ "NYCT",
    TRUE ~ manualid
  )))

summary(jf5$manualid)

#########################################################
# Utisra dataset
summary(ut)
summary(ut$Mid)
summary(ut$manualid)
names(ut)
#  [1] "...1"        "infile"      "outfile"     "DATE"        "night"      
#  [6] "autoid"      "manualid"    "match.ratio" "analyst"     "site"       
# [11] "Mid"         "behavior"    "analyst"

str(ut)
ut1 <- ut |>  dplyr::mutate(manualid = factor(dplyr::case_when(
  manualid == "CNIL" ~ "CNIL",
  manualid == "CNIL.B" ~ "CNIL",
  manualid == "ENIL" ~ "CNIL", 
  manualid == "NNOC" ~ "NNOC", 
  manualid == "NoID" ~ "NoID", 
  manualid == "Noise" ~ "Noise", 
  manualid == "NYCT" ~ "NYCT", 
  manualid == "PNAT" ~ "PNAT", 
  manualid == "PNAT.B" ~ "PNAT", 
  manualid == "PPYG" ~ "PPYG", 
  manualid == "PPYG.B" ~ "PPYG"))) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(filename = dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(infile) ~ outfile, 
                TRUE ~ infile)) |> 
  dplyr::rename(DATE.12 = night, 
         MATCH.RATIO = match.ratio) |> 
  dplyr::select(-1) |> 
  dplyr::select(-c(behavior, Mid, infile, outfile)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(newauto = 
    factor(dplyr::case_when(
    autoid == "BARBAR" ~ "BBAR",
    autoid == "EPTNIL" ~ "CNIL",
    autoid %in% c("MYOBRA", "MYODAU", 
                  "MYOMYS", "MYONAT") ~ "MYSP", 
    autoid  ==  "NoID" ~ "NoID",
    autoid  ==  "Noise" ~ "Noise",
    autoid  ==  "NYCNOC" ~ "NNOC",
    autoid  ==  "PIPNAT" ~ "PNAT",
    autoid  ==  "PIPPYG" ~ "PPYG",
    autoid  ==  "PLEAUR" ~ "PAUR",
    autoid  ==  "VESMUR" ~ "NYCT"))) 


summary(ut1$filename)
summary(ut1$manualid)
summary(ut1$newauto)
dim(ut1)
# 11398    13

names(ut1)
#  [1] "DATE"        "TIME"        "HOUR"        "DATE.12"     "TIME.12"    
#  [6] "HOUR.12"     "autoid"      "manualid"    "MATCH.RATIO" "analyst"    
# [11] "site"        "filename"    "newauto"  


#########################################################
# Gismarvik - Benedikte's thesis

gi <- GI |> 
  select(c("IN FILE", DATE, TIME, HOUR, 
           'DATE-12', 'TIME-12', 'HOUR-12', 
            "AUTO ID", "MATCH RATIO","MANUAL ID*" )) |> 
  rename(
  filename = 'IN FILE',
  DATE.12 = 'DATE-12',
  TIME.12 = 'TIME-12',
  HOUR.12 = 'HOUR-12',
  MATCH.RATIO = "MATCH RATIO",
  autoid = "AUTO ID",
  M1 = "MANUAL ID*") |> 
    mutate(DATE = as.Date(DATE), 
    DATE.12 = as.Date(DATE.12), 
    TIME = as.character(TIME), 
    TIME.12 = as.character(TIME.12),
    autoid = factor(autoid), 
    M1 = factor(M1)) 

summary(gi)
summary(gi$autoid)
summary(gi$M1)

gi1 <- gi |>  mutate(newauto = 
    factor(case_when(
    autoid == "BARBAR" ~ "BBAR",
    autoid == "EPTNIL" ~ "CNIL",
    autoid %in% c("MYOBRA", "MYODAU", 
                  "MYOMYS", "MYONAT") ~ "MYSP", 
    autoid  ==  "NoID" ~ "NoID",
    autoid  ==  "Noise" ~ "Noise",
    autoid  ==  "NYCNOC" ~ "NNOC",
    autoid  ==  "PIPNAT" ~ "PNAT",
    autoid  ==  "PIPPYG" ~ "PPYG",
    autoid  ==  "PLEAUR" ~ "PAUR",
    autoid  ==  "VESMUR" ~ "NYCT"))) |> 
  mutate(analyst = factor("Benedikte Oeyen"),
         site = factor("CM-46")) 
  

summary(gi1)
# Now to parse out and clean the manual ids 
gi2 <- gi1 |> separate_rows(M1, sep = "_") |> 
  mutate(M1 = factor(M1))

dim(gi1) # 5050   13
dim(gi2) # 5236   13

summary(gi2$M1)

gi2$mid1 <- factor(gsub("\\.B", "", gi2$M1))
levels(gi2$mid1)

gi2$mid2 <- factor(gsub("\\.S", "", gi2$mid1))
levels(gi2$mid2)

gi2$mid3 <- factor(gsub("\\.T", "", gi2$mid2))
levels(gi2$mid3)

gi2$mid4 <- factor(gsub("ENIL", "CNIL", gi2$mid3))
levels(gi2$mid4)

gi2$mid5 <- factor(gsub("MYOT", "MYSP", gi2$mid4))
levels(gi2$mid5)

## Account for multiple bats in each pass 
gi3 <- gi2 |> dplyr::select(-c(M1, mid1, mid2, mid3, mid4)) |> 
  rename(manualid = mid5)
summary(gi3)
summary(gi3$autoid)
summary(gi3$manualid)
dim(gi3)
# 5236   13
# looking good!

#########################################################
# Sara's thesis - Coastal sites in Rogaland 2024 

summary(sk)
names(sk)
sk1 <- sk |> 
  dplyr::select(c('IN FILE', DATE, TIME, HOUR, 
                  'DATE-12', 'TIME-12', 'HOUR-12', 
                  "AUTO ID", "MATCH RATIO","MANUAL ID*", 
                  "AUTO ID*", "MANUAL ID")) |> 
  dplyr::rename(
  filename = 'IN FILE',
  DATE.12 = 'DATE-12',
  TIME.12 = 'TIME-12',
  HOUR.12 = 'HOUR-12',
  MATCH.RATIO = "MATCH RATIO",
  A1 = "AUTO ID",
  A2 = "AUTO ID*", 
  M1 = "MANUAL ID",
  M2 = "MANUAL ID*") 

summary(sk1)

sk2 <- sk1  |>  
  dplyr::mutate(
    autoid = factor(dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(A1) ~ A2, 
    TRUE ~ A1))) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    manualid = factor(dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(M1) ~ M2, 
    TRUE ~ M1))) |> 
  dplyr::select(-c(M1, M2, A1, A2)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(newauto = 
    factor(dplyr::case_when(
    autoid == "BARBAR" ~ "BBAR",
    autoid == "EPTNIL" ~ "CNIL",
    autoid %in% c("MYOBRA", "MYODAU", 
                  "MYOMYS", "MYONAT") ~ "MYSP", 
    autoid  ==  "NoID" ~ "NoID",
    autoid  ==  "Noise" ~ "Noise",
    autoid  ==  "NYCNOC" ~ "NNOC",
    autoid  ==  "PIPNAT" ~ "PNAT",
    autoid  ==  "PIPPYG" ~ "PPYG",
    autoid  ==  "PLEAUR" ~ "PAUR",
    autoid  ==  "VESMUR" ~ "NYCT"))) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(analyst = factor("Sara Kristoffersson")) 

## Make a site column 
sitemap <- sk |> 
  dplyr::select("IN FILE", INDIR) |> 
  dplyr::rename(filename = "IN FILE" ) |> 
  unique()

summary(sitemap)
## super 
head(sitemap$INDIR)
sitemap$site <- factor(ifelse(grepl("CM-\\d{2}", sitemap$INDIR),
                  sub(".*(CM-\\d{2}).*", "\\1", sitemap$INDIR),
                  NA_character_)) 

summary(sitemap$site)
# CM-18 CM-19 CM-20 CM-22 CM-26 CM-28 CM-39 CM-40 CM-49 
#   491  1262   972  5445  3089  5231   306  1111  2194 
#Nice!

sitemap <- sitemap |> dplyr::select(c(site, filename))

sk3 <- dplyr::left_join(sk2, sitemap)

## Now cleaning the manualids 
summary(sk3$manualid)
## Up to 3 different taxa per manual ID 

## First lets simplify the noise recordings 
sk4 <- sk3 |> dplyr::mutate(
  mid = factor(dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(as.character(manualid), "Noise") ~ "Noise", 
    TRUE ~ manualid))) 
levels(sk4$mid)

## Remove the behavior tags, clean taxa names 
sk4$mid1 <- factor(gsub("\\.B", "", sk4$mid))
levels(sk4$mid1)

sk4$mid2 <- factor(gsub("\\.S", "", sk4$mid1))
levels(sk4$mid2)

sk4$mid3 <- factor(gsub("\\.T", "", sk4$mid2))
levels(sk4$mid3)

sk4$mid4 <- factor(gsub("ENIL", "CNIL", sk4$mid3))
levels(sk4$mid4)

sk4$mid5 <- factor(gsub("MYOT", "MYSP", sk4$mid4))
levels(sk4$mid5)

## Account for multiple bats in each pass 
sk5 <- sk4 |> dplyr::select(-c(mid, mid1, mid2, mid3, mid4))
summary(sk5)

sk6 <- sk5 |> tidyr::separate_rows(mid5, sep = "_") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(mid5 = factor(mid5))
dim(sk6)
# 22377    14

summary(sk6$mid5)
whatsthis <- sk6 |> dplyr::filter(mid5 == "NNOC.NYCT") |> droplevels()

sk7 <- sk6 |> dplyr::mutate(manualid = factor(
  dplyr::case_when(
    mid5 == "NNOC.NYCT" ~ "NYCT", 
    mid5 == "PPYG." ~ "PPYG",
    TRUE ~ mid5 
  ))) |> 
  dplyr::select(-mid5) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(DATE = as.Date(DATE), 
                DATE.12 = as.Date(DATE.12))

summary(sk7)
summary(sk7$manualid)

dim(sk7) # 22377    13
dim(ut1) # 11398    13
dim(jf4) # 50545    13

names(sk7)
names(ut1)
names(jf4)

## Sweet! Now we combine 

# SK + Utsira 
temp <- dplyr::full_join(ut1, sk7)
dim(temp)
# 33775    13
nrow(ut1) + nrow(sk7)
# checks out, good!

summary(temp)

# JF + Gismarvik 
temp1 <- dplyr::full_join(gi3, jf5)
dim(temp1)
# 55781    13
nrow(gi3) + nrow(jf4)
# 55781
# checks out, good!


temp2 <- full_join(temp, temp1)
dim(temp2)
nrow(temp) + nrow(temp1)
summary(temp2)

DF <- temp2 |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    autoid = factor(autoid),
    manualid = factor(manualid), 
    analyst = factor(analyst), 
    site = factor(site),
    newauto = factor(newauto)
  )

summary(DF)
summary(DF$autoid)
summary(DF$newauto)
summary(DF$manualid)
dim(DF)
# 89556    13
## Looking good! SEND IT!
# write.csv(DF, file = file.path(output_today, "CM_manualIDs_allavailable_subsets.csv"))
# 11.11.2026 - added Gismarvik CM-46!
```
